source_name: DOF Property Valuation and Assessment Data — Tax Classes 1,2,3,4 (PTS)
verification_note: Exact URL appeared in WebSearch results; snippet: 11.7M rows, 139 columns, last updated June 15 2026.
data_format: CSV/JSON via Socrata (SODA API, OData); bulk CSV export
update_frequency: Annual roll cycle (tentative roll ~Jan 15, final ~May 25); dataset updated through the cycle
terms_notes: NYC Open Data terms — free reuse, no login; API app-token recommended for throttling headroom.
difficulty_reason: Official citywide Socrata dataset with full API and bulk export.
notes: The full assessment roll (all tax classes, ~139 fields incl. market value, AV, transitional AV, exemptions). Key facts (from DOF pages surfaced in search snippets): assessment ratio Class 1 = 6% of market value; Classes 2/3/4 = 45%. NYC reassesses ANNUALLY (no multi-year cycle). Fractional caps: Class 1 AV +6%/yr, +20%/5yr; Class 2 (<11 units) +8%/yr, +30%/5yr; Class 2 11+ units and Class 4 have no cap but changes phase in over 5 years via transitional AV (bill uses lower of actual vs transitional). Class shares system: state law caps annual shift of each class's share of the levy.
